usage_policy.payment: Buyer-authorized only. A 402 quote is not a paid transaction; current live server quote is authoritative.
usage_policy.claims: No claim of certification, verified settlement, fulfilled service or exactly-once remote effects before independent evidence.

offers.when_useful: A buyer-authorized pre-execution assessment before an agent performs a consequential tool action.
offers.notes: A policy check is not payment authorization or settlement evidence.

offers.when_useful: An agent needs structured JSON cleanup for downstream processing.
Limited review of public website trust signals; not a security or legal certification.
Independent, scoped synthetic failure-path audit of one existing workflow.
Defined fourteen-day pilot for one agreed workflow, subject to authorized scope.

machine_buyer_example.step_1: Discover MCP tools or inspect the published OpenAPI.
machine_buyer_example.step_2: Select only the useful capability and call without payment to inspect current HTTP 402 terms.
machine_buyer_example.step_3: Validate amount, network, recipient, budget and caller authorization before any signature.
machine_buyer_example.step_4: Only if authorized, sign via the buyer's own supported x402 client; reconcile ambiguous outcomes before another spend.
machine_buyer_example.step_5: Verify service output and separate payment proof from deliverable evidence.
